title: Fix typos and unclear sentences in the Session 1 notes
body:
## Problem
The Session 1 notes may contain typos or sentences that a first-year student finds confusing.

## Context
Beginners judge the whole repo by Session 1.

## Expected outcome
A clearer `sessions/session-01/README.md` and `lesson.py` comments.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`, `sessions/session-01/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] At least three improvements
- [ ] `python start.py test` still passes

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add a colour-blind-safe palette to the live apps
body:
## Problem
The Session 3 app uses green, blue, orange and red lines for the equilibrium curve, the two operating lines and the stages; some colour-blind users cannot tell them apart.

## Context
Accessibility is part of the quality checklist (QUALITY.md, item 9).

## Expected outcome
A palette and line styles (dashes, markers) that stay distinguishable in light and dark mode.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-03/app.html`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] All four lines distinguishable in grayscale
- [ ] Screenshot added to the pull request

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add Session 4: energy balances on every tray
body:
## Problem
The roadmap's first milestone does not exist yet.

## Context
See `promo/roadmap.md`, Session 4. Students ask why the vapour flow is the same on every tray when ethanol and water have different latent heats.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-04/` with README (sections A to F), lesson, checkpoint, exercises and app in the same style as Sessions 1 to 3.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`, `sessions/session-03/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Checkpoint prints PASS and the roadmap checkpoint is met
- [ ] Added to the tests

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Add Session 5: Murphree tray efficiency
body:
## Problem
Session 3 counts ideal stages and divides by an overall efficiency; real design steps to a pseudo-equilibrium curve.

## Context
Roadmap Session 5.

## Expected outcome
A lesson and app where the Murphree efficiency is a slider and the staircase stops short of the equilibrium curve.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-03/lesson.py`, `promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] The roadmap checkpoint is met and shown in a figure
- [ ] Checkpoint added

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Reproduce the Target: a dynamic ethanol-water column from a cold start
body:
## Problem
The Target shows a column starting up tray by tray and settling to the Session 3 design; there is no public implementation.

## Context
The code behind the Target is private on purpose. The roadmap (Sessions 4, 5 and 7) gives the path.

## Expected outcome
Your own implementation, written from the roadmap, plus an animation or figure like the Target.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] At steady state: 13 stages, feed on stage 12, top tray about 78.5 C and bottom about 96.2 C, xD = 0.80 within 0.005
- [ ] Short write-up of your method

## Difficulty
advanced

title: Translate the Session 1 notes into Hindi
body:
## Problem
Students who prefer Hindi cannot read Session 1 comfortably.

## Context
This project teaches first- and second-year students across India; translations widen who can join.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-01/README.hi.md` with a faithful Hindi translation of sections A to F, linked from the main README.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] All sections translated
- [ ] Equations, code blocks and file names unchanged
- [ ] Link added to the main README

## Difficulty
beginner
